entry.title: Growth Needs a Before
entry.summary: A post-traumatic growth score can record a present perception of change without proving durable change, trauma-specific causality, or clinical recovery.

entry.title: What the Label Changes
entry.summary: A label can redirect looking and make an artwork feel more legible without making it more liked, learned, correct, or valuable.

entry.title: The Second Hearing
entry.summary: Repeated listening can change liking, prediction, attention, and memory in different ways. Replay count records exposure, not quality or a universal response.

entry.title: Availability Is Not Reach
entry.summary: Tutoring evidence is strong, but an offer is not delivery. Public claims must separate availability, reach, dosage, staffing, and outcomes.

entry.title: Five evidence lanes, one OpenAI and Hugging Face incident
entry.summary: Separate legal process, OpenAI's company report, Hugging Face host telemetry, independent analysis, and vendor remediation before drawing conclusions from the July incident.
